title: Sirah Shorts Special: The Man Allah Spoke To
fact_notes: Jami at-Tirmidhi 3010 (hasan: Albani, Ahmad Shakir) and Sunan Ibn Majah 190 (hasan), fetched from fawazahmed0/hadith-api on 2026-11-25

Lines 2-9 follow the hadith wording: Jabir upset/broken-hearted; father martyred on the Day of Uhud leaving family and debt; 'Allah does not speak to anyone except from behind a veil, but He spoke to your father directly'; 'ask of Me and I will give you'; 'give me life so I may be killed for You a second time'; 'it has been decreed that they shall not return'; 'convey to those I left behind' (Ibn Majah 190).
Father's name Abdullah (ibn Amr ibn Haram) is from Ibn Majah 190. 'Family and debts' also Sahih al-Bukhari 2781 (six daughters and debts).
Lines 10-11: Qur'an Al Imran 3:169 (Saheeh International via api.quran.com, checked 2026-11-25).
Line 12 is a reflection, not a claim. The Prophet (peace be upon him), Jabir and his father are never shown, not even as light.

lines.text: Allah speaks to no one except from behind a veil. But one man, He spoke to directly.
lines.spoken: Allah speaks to no one except from behind a veil. But one man, He spoke to directly.

lines.text: After Uhud, Jabir was broken-hearted. His father had been martyred.
lines.spoken: After Oohud, Jaabir was broken-hearted. His father had been martyred.

lines.text: He had left behind a family and debts.
lines.spoken: He had left behind a family and debts.

lines.text: The Prophet, peace be upon him, said: "Shall I give you glad news of your father?"
lines.spoken: The Prophet, peace be upon him, said: "Shall I give you glad news of your father?"

lines.text: "Allah spoke to him directly, and said: Ask of Me, and I will give you."
lines.spoken: "Allah spoke to him directly, and said: Ask of Me, and I will give you."

lines.text: He said: "My Lord, give me life again, to be killed for You a second time."
lines.spoken: He said: "My Lord, give me life again, to be killed for You a second time."

lines.text: Allah said: "It is decreed. They will not return."
lines.spoken: Allah said: "It is decreed. They will not return."

lines.text: He said: "Then tell those I left behind."
lines.spoken: He said: "Then tell those I left behind."

lines.text: So Allah revealed: "Never think of those killed in the cause of Allah as dead."
lines.spoken: So Allah revealed: "Never think of those killed in the cause of Allah as dead."

lines.text: "They are alive with their Lord, receiving provision."
lines.spoken: "They are alive with their Lord, receiving provision."

lines.text: Some grief hides glad news you cannot see yet. Next is Musa. Follow for Part 8.
lines.spoken: Some grief hides glad news you cannot see yet. Next is Moosa. Follow for Part eight.
